verdicts.name: STREAM_setpriority
verdicts.why: After a handle check, stores the two args at +0x4c/+0x50, where PS2 uses +0x3c/+0x40 (a consistent +0x10 shift); Xbox checks the 'STRM' magic inline where PS2 validates through FUN_00304e30.

verdicts.name: RRenderWorldCulling::Setup2dFrustrum
verdicts.why: Both call InitializePlaneInfo only when the fov/dist fields (+0x64/+0x68) differ, then atan of pos x/z, setyrot, rotate 5 planes, and the ABS(+0x24)*-0.2 scaleadd; Xbox transposes at the end.

intermediates.name: RRenderWorldCulling::InitializePlaneInfo
intermediates.why: Same body: stores fov/dist at +0x64/+0x68, cos/sin(fov*1/360) to +0x6c/+0x8c, length, then +0x80/+0x84=0, +0x88=dist*0.5, and normalised +0x7c/+0x90. Its only callers are Setup2dFrustrum and the ctor, as on PS2.

intermediates.name: RRenderWorldCulling::RRenderWorldCulling
intermediates.why: The PS2 ctor(float,float) is InitializePlaneInfo(a,b) and return this. Xbox 0x8d420 is identical and is the other caller of 0x8d370.

verdicts.name: EAGLAnim::AttributeBlock::GetAttribute
verdicts.why: Xbox 0xfab10 is not the binary search. It makes a vcall (+0x38, the PS2 +0x78/0x7c slot 14), calls 0x106800 and writes a byte out: an outlined attribute getter called only from UseFPS. The real GetAttribute is its callee.

intermediates.name: EAGLAnim::AttributeBlock::FindAttribute
intermediates.why: Same binary search over the count at [0] and ushort ids at +4 stride 8; returns the entry pointer or 0.

intermediates.name: EAGLAnim::AttributeBlock::GetAttribute
intermediates.why: FindAttribute(id), then on a hit *out = entry[1] and return true. This matches PS2 0x266d30 (the inline-search overload that stores piVar1[1]), not the memcpy overload at 0x266ba0.

verdicts.name: ActSkeleton::BlendBones
verdicts.why: Same per-bone loop: VU0_fastqslerp at +0x10, then a lerp of +0x20/+0x24/+0x28 when flag==1 or index==[+0x18], with stride 0x30. Xbox inlines GetNumBones as [[+8]+8].

verdicts.name: WCollisionMgr::WCollisionMgr
verdicts.why: Same ctor: two STL trees at +0x18/+0x24 (PS2 +0x14/+0x20), [0..4]=0, [0xb]=0xf0 and [0xc]=0 on both.

verdicts.name: ActActor::RotateActor
verdicts.why: Calls Poser::Rotate(angle) first, then if flag +0x14 builds a y-rotation from cos/sin into the matrix at [+0xc]+0x340 via VU0_MATRIX4_mult, as PS2.

verdicts.name: Shell::Shell
verdicts.why: PhysicsObject("weapon","Shell",7) base ctor and a SimpleRigidBody set-up from the same args, as PS2 Shell::Shell. It is the only 1:1 slot in SpawnShellObject.

verdicts.name: RCMP::CODEC_IDATA::CODEC_IDATA
verdicts.why: Identical 4-field ctor with the same store order ([3]=p4, [0]=p1, [1]=p2, [2]=p3) that returns this; the only caller on both sides is GetFirstFrame.

verdicts.name: ActCharacter::EndShadow
verdicts.why: Position is exact: in the shadow block of ActCharacter::Draw, Xbox calls 0x14760 / Model::Draw / 0x147d0 where PS2 calls StartShadow / Draw / EndShadow. PS2 EndShadow is empty; the Xbox one restores D3D state (e7890(0) undoes StartShadow's e7890(1)).

intermediates.name: ActCharacter::StartShadow
intermediates.why: Called immediately before the shadow Model::Draw in ActCharacter::Draw, where PS2 calls StartShadow. It sets stencil state (0x1e00/0x1e01/0x205, ...) that EndShadow (0x147d0) undoes.

verdicts.name: WRoadNav::ChangeLanes
verdicts.why: Same fields: if p2>0 it sets +0x98/+0x9c from +0xa0, then +0xa0=p1, +0xa4=0, +0xa8=0, +0xac=p2; otherwise it rebuilds lane splines from fSegments[+0x3e].

verdicts.name: OBB::OBB
verdicts.why: Trivial ctor (mov eax,ecx; ret), but the caller set is identical on both sides: Missile::CheckForCollision, RayShell::CollideWithObjects, ~EWakeupSmackable, and CheckCollisions (Xbox 0xb1ff0). There are no other callers, so it has not been folded.

verdicts.name: EAGL::ViewPort::SetViewMatrix
verdicts.why: Copies the 16-dword matrix into +0x80; if the flag at +0x188 is set, re-begins the view (BeginView), which is PS2's ReBegin. Xbox and PS2 share 3 anchors in 1:1 slots and the same caller set.

verdicts.name: AICharacterPedestrian::SetNewState
verdicts.why: Xbox 0x239b0 decrements fRoads[n]->+0x2f, a road-node ped count. Xbox inlines SetNewState (+0x5c=0x16, +0x14c=old, +0x60/+0x19c=0), so the slot pairs the next call. PS2 inlines this decrement in KillSelf, so it has no PS2 counterpart.

verdicts.name: AICharacterPedestrian::GetSpecialPedInfo
verdicts.why: Same Xbox function as item 228 (the fRoads[n]+0x2f decrement); the body is unrelated to the GetSpecialPedInfo table lookup.

verdicts.name: PhysicsObject::GetRadius
verdicts.why: Same body: flag bit 0 selects GetRigidBody()->+0x7c or GetSimpleRigidBody()->+0x2c, using the rigid-body slot at +0x4a.

verdicts.name: RTextureContextManager::KillContext
verdicts.why: Walks the map at this+4 and erases every node whose value equals the arg (Xbox node value +0x10 = PS2 +0x14). Xbox calls the erase as 0x94140 where PS2 inlines the rb-erase and FastFree(0x18).

verdicts.name: RCMP::DECODER::GetFrame
verdicts.why: Same lazy-open then vcall: if decoder [+0x18] (PS2 +0x14) is null and [+4] (PS2 [0]) is null, call fn[+0xc](this,[+8],this+4); then return 0 or the decoder's vcall. A consistent +4 shift.

verdicts.name: ATrafficVehicle::PlaySnowmobileSpecifics
verdicts.why: The SFX_heavy1 / "Opponents" GetVolume / Lookup sound strings are shared (7 strings), with the airborne-wheels gate and the +0x220..+0x238 fields; it is the 1:1 slot in ATrafficVehicle::Play.

verdicts.name: memset
verdicts.why: Xbox 0x1d9f0 is a struct ctor (copies a 4-float default from 0x1d4c00, copies 8 dwords, zeroes +0x40..+0x58), not memset. PS2 inlines this set-up, so the n:n slot is wrong.

verdicts.name: EAGL::DynamicLoader::GetRegisteredVar
verdicts.why: Xbox 0x9ac40 is a ctor that allocates 'EAGL::Rendermethod new' and fetches gpModelViewProjectionMatrix, so it only calls GetRegisteredVar: the slot pairs the caller of the real function.

intermediates.name: EAGL::DynamicLoader::GetRegisteredVar
intermediates.why: Body is SymbolPool::Search(&varPool, name, found) (ecx=0x23fb8c). It sits right after RegisterVar (0xe5cc0) and UnRegisterVar (0xe5ce0), the PS2 order, and is called by 0x9ac40 with 'EAGL::ViewPort::gpModelViewProjectionMatrix' as PS2 DrawGouraud does.

verdicts.name: SetProcAnimXFormList
verdicts.why: Identical: if p1 is non-null, set the global list pointer and count; else the default list with count 1.

verdicts.name: StringToNumber::StringToNumber
verdicts.why: Same: counts the null-terminated 8-byte table, stores count/table, and if the count is >= 0x1f allocates count<<4 with FastAlloc("StringToNumber") and sorts with qsort.

verdicts.name: SMissionManager::FailObjective
verdicts.why: Xbox inlines GetObjectiveByID (a list walk matching *entry==id) and sets objective+0x10 = 3, as PS2 piVar1[4]=3; logWarning is stripped in the release build. The sibling (item 248) sets 1.

verdicts.name: RScorchWorld::ScorchGround
verdicts.why: Same flow: FindClosestFace, early-outs on face flag +0x2d&2, type 6 and +0x34 material, radius = min(size*0.5, 6.0), HeightAtPoint, normal y >= 0.95, then 4 neighbour height probes (<0.15).

verdicts.name: RSceneObj::ComputeBoundingRadius
verdicts.why: Xbox inlines GetBoundingDimensions as the half extents ((max-min)*0.5 from [+0x10] +0x10..+0x28), then takes the vector length, as PS2 (dims, then length with VU0).

verdicts.name: dpsub
verdicts.why: Xbox 0x14880 is a pointer min (returns the pointer to the smaller float, std::min<float>-like), not a soft-float subtract. The PS2 callers are unrelated.

verdicts.name: RDrawGroup::RDrawGroup
verdicts.why: Same: FastAlloc("RReverseDrawList") of a 3-word zeroed list stored at [0]. Xbox allocates 0x10 with a null check where PS2 allocates 0xc.

verdicts.name: EAGL::TAR::SwapClut
verdicts.why: Called in RuntimeAllocTARConstructor's CLUTNAME branch after the shape_ symbol lookup, where PS2 calls TAR::SwapClut. Like PS2 TARExtension::SwapClut (inlined here), it locates the '*' clut chunk with the same +0x1000 flag relative-offset logic, then uploads it to a D3D palette instead of re-initialising the GS image.

verdicts.name: GHud::IsFlyByWireOn
verdicts.why: Xbox 0xeecf0 is a GeoPrimState blend-mode setter (switch writing D3D blend factors 0x302/0x303/0x306 and op 0x8006 to +0x30..+0x38; it sits between SetDepthTestMethod and SetAlphaTestMethod), not the IsFlyByWireOn predicate.

verdicts.name: RSniperZoom::SetupVerts
verdicts.why: Same loop over the verts at +0xb60: alternating radii from two globals, (i/2)*0.05 (PS2 /20.0), a helper call, alpha from [+8]<<24 and white 0xffffff/0x7f7f7f.

verdicts.name: MATRIX4_mult
verdicts.why: A 4x4 matrix multiply: copies to the temp at 0x2420f0 when the operands alias, then 4 row calls (hand-written FPU asm rows), as PS2 MATRIX4_mult with its alias temp. It sits in the Xbox MATRIX4_* asm group (multxlate 0x108840, multscale 0x108900).

verdicts.name: WVisCurtain::WVisCurtain
verdicts.why: Copies two COORD4 refs into [0..3]/[4..7] and sets [3] = distance from p1 to the 0.5 midpoint: CalcRadius inlined. This is the (COORD4&,COORD4&) overload 0x22f660 (the other ctor, 0x22f620, takes six floats).

verdicts.name: SMissionManager::SetCurrentObjective
verdicts.why: Twin of item 238: inlined GetObjectiveByID then objective+0x10 = 1, as PS2 SetCurrentObjective piVar1[4]=1.

verdicts.name: ActActor::RotateActorX
verdicts.why: Same as RotateActor (item 221) but calls Poser::RotateX and builds an x-rotation from cos/sin, applied to [+0xc]+0x340.

verdicts.name: EAGL::RenderContext::EndFrame
verdicts.why: Platform EndFrame (texture unbinds, render state resets, D3DDevice_Swap where PS2 waits on DMA and swaps buffers). The PS2 and Xbox callers match in 4 anchors, all 1:1 slots: RRenderer::EndFrame/Flush and GLoadingScreen x2.

verdicts.name: RReflection::TextureSpecular
verdicts.why: Unambiguous by string position in RCARPFile::RegisterSymbols: 'GAME::ReflectionMap1' and 'GAME::SpecularMap' both call it on both platforms (PS2 TextureSpecular). A getter [+0x4c]->+0x124 (PS2 [+0x58]->+0xd0).

intermediates.name: RReflection::GetReflectionMapWarpageData
intermediates.why: Returned for 'GAME::FishEyeParams' in RegisterSymbols on both platforms; the getter returns [+0x4c]+0x270.

intermediates.name: RReflection::GetReflectionCarPos
intermediates.why: Returned for 'GAME::ReflectionCarPos' on both; returns [+0x4c]+0x180, the block that SetReflectivity (0x99610) fills with the car position.

intermediates.name: RReflection::TextureWeaponEnvMap
intermediates.why: Returned for 'GAME::WeaponReflectionMap' on both; returns [[+0x4c]+0x11c]. It sits just before TextureSpecular (0x98490) and Texture (0x984a0), the PS2 order.

verdicts.name: qsort
verdicts.why: MSVC CRT qsort (median-of-three with _shortsort for spans of 8 or fewer); the same routine as newlib qsort under the same name. The caller set matches: AIElementController::Update, WTargetPicker::UpdateTargets, and StringToNumber (0x119f50, item 237).

verdicts.name: URefCounter<ActModelDatabase::ModelInfo>::URefCounter
verdicts.why: Xbox 0x94070 is not a URefCounter ctor: it ignores this and only allocates an 0x98 'STL' tree head node (+0x94 isnil=1): MSVC _Tree::_Buynode, shared by every URefCounter<T>::Get. PS2 inlines this into each ctor.

verdicts.name: URefCounter<ActTextureDatabase::TextureInfo>::URefCounter
verdicts.why: Same shared _Buynode as item 253 (no this, only the head-node alloc).

verdicts.name: URefCounter<ActWeaponDatabase::WeaponInfo>::URefCounter
verdicts.why: Same shared _Buynode as item 253.

verdicts.name: URefCounter<RTextureContext>::URefCounter
verdicts.why: Same shared _Buynode as item 253.

verdicts.name: URefCounter<AMix>::URefCounter
verdicts.why: Same shared _Buynode as item 253.

verdicts.name: URefCounter<AStream>::URefCounter
verdicts.why: Same shared _Buynode as item 253.

verdicts.name: URefCounter<AFader>::URefCounter
verdicts.why: Same shared _Buynode as item 253.

verdicts.name: URefCounter<ABank>::URefCounter
verdicts.why: Same shared _Buynode as item 253.

verdicts.name: URefCounter<AEngine>::URefCounter
verdicts.why: Same shared _Buynode as item 253.

verdicts.name: RLightning::Point::Update
verdicts.why: Point update: if t-[+0xc] > 0, pos+vel*dt plus a random coord scaled by [+0x3c] (GetRandomCoord inlined: the table index at fgThis+0x650 advances by 5, &0x3f) into +0x20; else copies pos to +0x20. The early-out matches PS2.

verdicts.name: RLightning::Bolt::~Bolt
verdicts.why: Same Xbox function as item 262 (Point::Update body); it does no vector/array deletes, so it is not ~Bolt.

verdicts.name: RWorldCamera::SetViewingTransform
verdicts.why: Same offsets shifted +0x10: flag (PS2 +0x50 / Xbox +0x60) = 1, dir = (+0xd0)-(+0xc0) (PS2 +0xc0-+0xb0) normalised, cross products for the up/right rows, w column 0/1, optional copy of arg 2.

verdicts.name: EAGL::GeoPrimState::~GeoPrimState
verdicts.why: The empty Xbox dtor sits right after GeoPrimState::GeoPrimState (0xef480). It is called at the end of RStateManager::GetGeoPrimState to destroy the local GeoPrimState (PS2 calls ~GeoPrimState(,2) there), by member dtors such as 0xf5b60, and by EH unwind funclets. PS2's extension teardown has no Xbox equivalent.

verdicts.name: GGallery::FONT_Load
verdicts.why: Identical: FONT_destroy if +0xa8 is set, frees the old buffer at +0xac (MEM_free where PS2 uses FileFree), FileLoad(name), FONT_create into +0xa8.

verdicts.name: ActCharacter::SetAlpha
verdicts.why: *[+0x68] = round(alpha*255), as PS2 *this->alpha = (int)(a*255 +- 0.5).

verdicts.name: EAGL::DrawGouraud::InternalFlush
verdicts.why: Called after the region loop in ProfilerRegion::DrawRegions and from DrawRegion, as PS2 InternalFlush (the same 2 callers). The Xbox flush is platform code: if the batch is open (+0x58), D3DDevice_End then Begin(prim).

verdicts.name: strcmp
verdicts.why: Xbox 0xf3c90 is the SymbolPool string hash (h ^= h<<5 ^ c, then % [+4]), not strcmp. It is called only by SymbolPool::Search/RemoveSymbol.

intermediates.name: EAGL::SymbolPool::HashFunction
intermediates.why: Identical hash loop (h = h ^ h<<5 ^ c) and return h % this->[+4]; its callers are Search and RemoveSymbol.

verdicts.name: RReflection::SetReflectivity
verdicts.why: First call in SendPerCarInstance's 'car changed' block on both. Uses the same reflectivity table ([+0x4c/+0x58]->+0xa0 + idx*0x80, indexed by the car byte at +0x1c/+0x18) and writes shader constants (car pos at +0x180) where PS2 builds GIF state.

verdicts.name: ATurret::~ATurret
verdicts.why: Xbox 0x11ec10 destroys two embedded AVoice::View[3] arrays (+0x10 and +0x68). That is the AVehicle member at +0x1d0, which PS2 ~AVehicle inlines (the +0x1ec object with View arrays at +0x10 and +0x74). ~ATurret is a different Xbox function.

intermediates.name: ATurret::~ATurret
intermediates.why: Frees three View-array blocks at +8, +0xc, +4 in that order (the PS2 ~ATurret order). It sits between ATurret::ATurret (0x12e220) and ATurret::Play (0x12e2b0), and ~AVehicle calls it on the turret pointer (+0x18c) before the zoom object.

verdicts.name: Simulation::FindSignature
verdicts.why: Signature lookup: the sign bit selects the table (+0x30 rigid / +0x130 simple, i.e. FindRigidBodySignature/FindSimpleRigidBodySignature inlined), sets *isSimple, index = sig>>24 & 0x7f, returns the index only when the stored signature matches.

verdicts.name: EAGL::TextureRenderContextExtension::TextureRenderContextExtension
verdicts.why: *this = arg. It is the first call in TextureRenderContext::TextureRenderContext (push esi; call with ecx=this: Extension(this,this)) and has no other caller.

intermediates.name: EAGLInternal::TextureRenderContextPrivate::TextureRenderContextPrivate
intermediates.why: The second ctor call in TextureRenderContext::TextureRenderContext (this+4, owner=this), as PS2 Private(this+8, this). The body stores the owner and zeroes the fields.

verdicts.name: RSceneObj::GetTransform
verdicts.why: Copies the 4x4 from [+0xc] (PS2 this+8) and forces the w column to 0,0,0,1, as PS2. Xbox and PS2 share 3 anchors in 1:1 slots.

verdicts.name: RViewCamera::RefreshLODMultiplier
verdicts.why: lodMultiplier (+0x34) = camera->[+0xb4] * (1/33) * (xMax-xMin) * (1/400), the same constants as PS2 (/33 /400).

verdicts.name: RSceneObj::RenderAllDeferredEffects
verdicts.why: Loops the same draw-last list as RSceneObj::RenderAllDrawLast (0x1f1cf4/0x1f1d00), calling vtable slot 5 (+0x14), where PS2 RenderArray(0,1,...) calls slot 5 (0x30/0x34) on the same list as RenderAllDrawLast.

verdicts.name: strcmp
verdicts.why: Xbox 0x22770 calls a callback count times (an MSVC vector-ctor-iterator helper), not strcmp; the slot has no caller chain.

verdicts.name: Missile::Missile
verdicts.why: 8 shared strings; the same callee set (FindPhysicsObjectSignature, GetSimpleRigidBody, RMissileStreak, SetRenderObject, AddReference, stricmp/strcasecmp); the 1:1 slot in SpawnMissileObject.

verdicts.name: AIGroundVehicle::DisengageAutoDrive
verdicts.why: Same sequence: GetPhysicsObject->vslot 17 (Xbox +0x44 / PS2 +0x90/0x94) with 0, then vslot 21 (+0x54 / +0xb0/0xb4). The SetAttackMode/SetNavigateMode effects are inlined as flag stores, then SetSplinePath(0), and +0x178 (PS2 +0x1a4) = 0.

verdicts.name: USimpleVec<RLightning::Segment>::~USimpleVec
verdicts.why: Xbox 0x9f8b0 is a resize (delete the old array, vec_new n*0x18+4, construct n Segments), not a destructor. PS2 inlines this resize into BuildNewSegment/AddBolt (which call ~USimpleVec plus vec_new directly).

verdicts.name: RPlayerCamera::SetControlToCPU
verdicts.why: Single store into the sub-object at [+0x354] (a byte at +7 where PS2 stores an int at +0x10), with the same 4 caller dtors on both sides and the same arguments (EControlToCPU 1, EControlToPlayer 0, EControlToSpline 1, EEndControlToSpline 0).

verdicts.name: RFog::SetFogParams
verdicts.why: Last call of RFog::RFog on both. It inlines CalcFogEnd (end = scale*base, [+4] = [+0x18]*[+0x14]), then pushes start/end/density/mode/colour through 5 render-state setters where PS2 builds the GS fog and calls SetFogColour.

intermediates.name: RFog::UpdateScale
intermediates.why: Same body: if the flag at +8 is set, scale = base(+0x18) - (count(+0xc) - frame)*rate(+0x10), or snaps to the base and clears the flag, then CalcFogEnd (inlined) and SetFogParams (0x7d840). Called from RRenderHigh::Render, as PS2 via StopFrameRender.

verdicts.name: GHud::LetterBoxOff
verdicts.why: +0x2b4 (PS2 +0x2b0) = arg ? 1 : 3; a +4 shift.

verdicts.name: AttributeSystem::RegisterExtensionField
verdicts.why: Called as (type, "MASS"/"HITPOINTS"/"DESCRIPTION"/..., parser, offset, 1, 0, 0) in PhysicsNamespace::PhysicsNamespace, with arguments identical to PS2 RegisterExtensionField. The body looks up the type map, then inserts the field record.

intermediates.name: AttributeSystem::RegisterExtensionType
intermediates.why: Called just before the field registrations as ("smackable","PhysicsData",0x2c,fn), the same arguments as PS2 RegisterExtensionType; its result is the type handle passed to each RegisterExtensionField.

verdicts.name: WCollider::~WCollider
verdicts.why: Calls Clear, then frees three vectors with the same element sizes (8, 0x28, 8) at +0x54/+0x44/+0x34 (PS2 +0x48/+0x3c/+0x30) in the same order.

verdicts.name: RParticleSystem::RParticle::ResetParticle
verdicts.why: Same particle reset: position jitter with the 16-bit LCG random (*1/32768 range), velocity from emitter dirs +0x30/+0x20 scaled by random ranges, optional 1/60 inherited velocity, life/size bytes, atan and GetCurrentViewPort use.
